name: search-input
title: Search Input
description: A token-safe search field with a consistent clear action, controlled and uncontrolled value handling, and native form semantics.

meta.whenToUse: A reusable search field with a consistent token-colored clear action, and a settled (debounced, Enter-flushed) value for sending the query.
meta.whenNotToUse: A general text field without search semantics, or a command palette with result navigation.
